spans.s: प्रति—चक्र n. a discus which is a match for any other, MBh.
a hostile army, Nīlak.
प्रति—चन्द्र m. a mock moon, paraselene, R.
प्रति—चरणम् ind. in every school or branch, L.
प्रति—चिति ind. in every layer or pile, KātyŚr.
प्रति—चोदनम् ind. on every order or injunction, ĀśvŚr.
प्रति-˚चोदनम् See p. 662, col. 1.

any image, likeness, substitute, Hariv.; Rājat.
प्रति—च्छन्द—कल्याण mfn. obliging, complaisant, L.
प्रति—च्छन्दक m. = -च्छन्द, Kull.
प्रति—च्छन्दक mfn. versed in, familiar with, Nalac.
प्रति—च्छाया f. reflection, likeness, image, shadow, phantom, Hariv.; Śaṃk.
the distorted image of a sick man (indicative of approaching death), Car.
प्रति—च्छाया—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of the dist˚ im˚ of a sick man, ib.
प्रति—च्छायिका f. an image, phantom, Naiṣ.
wishing to requite (loc.), HPariś.
See प्रति-√ कृ.
प्रति-˚चिकीर्षा f. wish to requite, desire to be revenged upon (acc. or loc.), MBh.; BhP.
प्रति-˚चिकीर्षु mfn. wishing to return or requite, MBh. (v.l. -जिहीर्षु).
प्रति-˚चक्ष See सु-प्रतिचक्ष॑.
प्रति-˚च॑क्षण n. looking at, viewing, RV.; BhP. (showing, displaying Sch.)
appearance, look, aspect, AV.
प्रति-˚चक्षिन् mfn. regarding, observing, AV.Paipp.
प्रति-˚च॑क्ष्य mf(आ)n. visible, conspicuous, RV.

प्रति-√ चर् P. -चरति, to advance towards, approach, RV.; TS.;
 Caus. -चारयति See below.
प्रति-˚चार m. personal adornment, toilet, Śīl.
प्रति-˚चारित mfn. (fr. Caus.) circulated, proclaimed, published, MBh.
प्रति-˚चारिन् mfn. exercising, practising, L.

प्रति-√ चिन्त् P. Ā. -चिन्तयति, ˚ते, to consider again, reflect upon, remember, R.;
 Caur.
प्रति-˚चिन्तन n. thinking repeatedly, considering, W.
प्रति-˚चिन्तनीय mfn. to be thought over again, Kāv.
प्रति-√ चुद् Caus. -चोडयति, to drive or urge on, impel, R.
प्रति-˚चोदना f. prevention, prohibition, BhP. (= निषेध, opp. to विधि, or = स्मृति, opp. to श्रुति, Sch.)
प्रति-˚चोदित mfn. impelled or excited against (acc.), R.
P. -च्छादयति to cover, envelop, hide, conceal, Kauś.; MBh. &c.
प्रति-˚च्छदन n. a cover, covering, L.
प्रति-˚च्छन्न mfn. covered, enveloped, hidden, concealed, disguised, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
endowed or furnished with (ifc.), MBh. iii, 1268.

P. -च्छिनत्ति to cut or tear off, ŚāṅkhŚr. (v.l. प्र-च्छ्˚);
to retaliate by cutting to pieces, MBh.
प्रति-˚च्छेद m. cutting off
resistance, opposition, W.
pressing closer against or towards, RV. x, 86, 6.

one who receives, a receiver, Mn. iv, 194.
(with or scil. दिश्) the west, AV. &c. &c.
N. of a river, BhP.
of प्रत्य॑ञ्च्.
प्रतीची—पति m. ‘lord of the west’, N. of Varuṇa, the ocean, Prasannar.

turned towards, going or coming t˚, RV.
turned away from, turning the back, RV.
being behind, coming from b˚, AV.
turning westward, western, TS.; Br.
subsequent, future (with abl.), RV.; TBr.
(अम्), ind. back to one's self, TBr.
backwards, behind, TS.; TBr.; Kāṭh.; BhP.
प्रतीची॑न—ग्रीव (प्रतीची॑न-), mfn. having the neck turned westward, Br.
प्रतीची॑न—प्रजनन (प्रतीची॑न-), mfn., ŚBr.
प्रतीची॑न—फल (प्रतीची॑न-), mfn. having fruit turned or bending backwards, ib.; AV.
प्रतीचीन—मुख mf(ई॑)n. having the face turned westward, ŚBr.
प्रतीची॑न—शिरस् (प्रतीची॑न-), mfn. having the head turned westward, ib.
